parts.name: frame shell

physics.Basic_description: The main white cylindrical body of the gun, appearing as a smooth, matte plastic housing.
physics.Functional_description: Holds the caulking cartridge in place and provides the structural backbone for the mechanism.
physics.Grasped_description: A parallel jaw gripper would grasp the cylindrical body firmly from the sides to stabilize the tool.
physics.reason: It is a molded plastic housing designed to contain a cartridge, so the interior is empty air space.

parts.description: The main white cylindrical body of the gun, appearing as a smooth, matte plastic housing.
parts.function: Holds the caulking cartridge in place and provides the structural backbone for the mechanism.

parts.name: pivot pin

physics.Basic_description: A tiny metallic pin, likely hidden or flush within the assembly, serving as a hinge point.
physics.Functional_description: Acts as the pivot axis for the trigger mechanism relative to the frame.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and embedded to be grasped directly; manipulation would occur via the connected parts.
physics.reason: Pivot pins are typically solid metal rods to withstand shear forces.

parts.description: A tiny metallic pin, likely hidden or flush within the assembly, serving as a hinge point.
parts.function: Acts as the pivot axis for the trigger mechanism relative to the frame.

parts.name: dring loop

physics.Basic_description: A black, flexible rubber loop hanging from the handle area.
physics.Functional_description: Allows the tool to be hung on a hook or carried by hand.
physics.Grasped_description: A gripper could hook a finger into the loop to lift the object, though it offers poor stability for manipulation.
physics.reason: While it has a hole, the material itself is a solid cross-section of rubber, not a thin-walled shell enclosing air.

parts.description: A black, flexible rubber loop hanging from the handle area.
parts.function: Allows the tool to be hung on a hook or carried by hand.

parts.name: cartridge body

physics.Basic_description: A yellowish-white cylindrical tube visible inside the frame, representing the sealant container.
physics.Functional_description: Contains the caulking material that is extruded during use.
physics.Grasped_description: Could be grasped if exposed, but typically held by the frame; gripping here might deform the soft plastic.
physics.reason: Standard caulking cartridges are thin-walled plastic tubes filled with paste, modeled here as the container shell.

parts.description: A yellowish-white cylindrical tube visible inside the frame, representing the sealant container.
parts.function: Contains the caulking material that is extruded during use.

parts.name: front collar

physics.Basic_description: A white ring at the front end of the barrel, matching the frame material.
physics.Functional_description: Secures the front of the cartridge and guides the nozzle assembly.
physics.Grasped_description: Too narrow and close to the nozzle to be a primary grasp point.
physics.reason: It is a ring-shaped structural component with an opening for the cartridge/nozzle.

parts.description: A white ring at the front end of the barrel, matching the frame material.
parts.function: Secures the front of the cartridge and guides the nozzle assembly.

parts.name: nozzle

physics.Basic_description: A black, conical tip protruding from the front of the gun.
physics.Functional_description: Directs the flow of caulk and allows for precise application.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasping the nozzle would be unstable and could damage the tip or misalign the cartridge.
physics.reason: Nozzles are hollow cones to allow material to pass through.

parts.description: A black, conical tip protruding from the front of the gun.
parts.function: Directs the flow of caulk and allows for precise application.

parts.name: trigger blade

physics.Basic_description: A light blue/cyan curved lever located below the barrel.
physics.Functional_description: Pressed by the user's finger to advance the plunger and dispense caulk.
physics.Grasped_description: A gripper finger would press against this to actuate the tool, or grasp it to hold the gun orientation.
physics.reason: Triggers are typically solid molded plastic pieces to resist bending forces during actuation.

parts.description: A light blue/cyan curved lever located below the barrel.
parts.function: Pressed by the user's finger to advance the plunger and dispense caulk.

parts.name: plunger rod

physics.Basic_description: A magenta/purple rod extending from the rear of the gun with a flat T-shaped handle.
physics.Functional_description: Pushes against the back of the cartridge plunger to extrude the sealant.
physics.Grasped_description: The T-handle at the end provides a good feature for a gripper to pull or push the rod manually.
physics.reason: Plunger rods must be solid to transmit compressive force without buckling.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
